WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    AVG(ds.points) as avg_points,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_record_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.name,
    s1.avg_points,
    s1.record_count,
    s1.record_count - s2.avg_record_count as difference
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s1.record_count > s2.avg_record_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_points) as result_1,
  AVG(record_count) as result_2,
  AVG(difference) as result_3
FROM step3
